description: HP-47 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) office for Dalhousie in Himachal Pradesh. It operates under the Sub Divisional Magistrate (SDM) of Dalhousie and manages vehicle registrations and driving licenses for the Dalhousie sub-division.
address: Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Dalhousie, District Chamba, Himachal Pradesh
